description: Originally named Toncoin (TON), Gram (GRAM) is the native coin of The Open Network (TON). Now as a 1:1 GRAM price-indexed token on AtlantisChain — the world's ONLY ultra-super-fast Layer-0 blockchain with 3,600,000 TPS and 0.031-second block time — ATC-20 GRAM gives original TON and GRAM holders, users, and traders from other chains instant finality, fixed ultra-low gas fees, and AI contract capability, turning it into a much faster, more secure, and more scalable asset worldwide.
name: Gram
